bias.zh: 看空 · 跌破 200 日均线，超卖

read.en: AMD fell 17.3% on Nov 5 to $404.40, trading $402.10–456.20 on about three times its 20-day average volume. It closed below the rising 200-day ($415.0) and stays under the falling 5-day ($469.74), 10-day ($510.19), 30-day ($565.34) and 100-day ($527.50). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9, below zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($564.60), and RSI is 30.
read.zh: AMD 11月5日下跌 17.3%，收于 $404.40，盘中区间 $402.10–456.20，成交量约为 20 日均量的 3 倍。收盘跌破上行的 200 日均线（$415.0），并继续位于下行的 5 日（$469.74）、10 日（$510.19）、30 日（$565.34）和 100 日均线（$527.50）下方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$564.60），RSI 为 30。

read.en: The gap lower broke all three written supports ($440.5–476.5) and the 200-day, closing near the low. Resistance is $415 (200-day), then $424 (Jul 29 low) and $440.5–451 (Sep 3 and Aug 24 lows). Support is $400–402 (Nov 5 low), then $393.4 (May 19 low) and $355–363 (May 5 close, May 1 high). A close back above $415 would target $424; below $393, $363.
read.zh: 跳空下跌跌破全部三个原有支撑（$440.5–476.5）和 200 日均线，收于全日低位附近。阻力为 $415（200 日均线），其次 $424（7月29日低点）和 $440.5–451（9月3日和8月24日低点）。支撑为 $400–402（11月5日低点），其次 $393.4（5月19日低点）和 $355–363（5月5日收盘、5月1日高点）。若收盘重新站上 $415，下一目标看 $424；若跌破 $393，则看 $363。
